description: Fallback for any local SMB that doesn't match a specific industry

examples.headline: Brambleton's #1 Rated Business
examples.hook: 178 five-star reviews from your neighbors. Not Yelp paid — just people who keep coming back. ⭐
examples.body: Brambleton locals have been trusting us for 11 years — not because we're the cheapest, but because we actually show up, do the job right, and follow up. Family-owned and Loudoun-based. Schedule online in 60 seconds or call and talk to a real person. 📞
examples.image_prompt: Medium candid shot of a business owner in their element — working behind a counter or in their space — genuine smile toward a customer, warm natural light, real and lived-in business environment with character, shot on Sony A7R IV f/1.8, warm golden color grade, authentic not staged, 4:5 vertical crop, photorealistic

examples.angle: PAIN POINT — bad experience elsewhere, better option here
examples.headline: Finally, One That Shows Up
examples.hook: Tired of booking someone who ghosts you? We text you a confirmation, a reminder, and an ETA. Every time. 📲
examples.body: Loudoun families switched to us after one too many no-shows and unanswered calls. We built our whole operation around communication — because that's the part everyone else gets wrong. Read our reviews if you don't believe us. First-time customers get 10% off. 💯
examples.image_prompt: Over-the-shoulder medium shot of a business owner on a phone call at their workspace, relaxed and confident, warm afternoon light through a window, clean and organized environment that signals professionalism, genuine expression of listening, shot on Sony A7R IV f/2.0, warm neutral color grade, 4:5 vertical crop, photorealistic
